probe.text_sample: Your Page Title kinfolk ® Shop Journal Help About Contact Overview Buy Kinfolk 0 0 0 0 Categories Show all 13 Face 5 Body 4 Refills 3 Gift cards 1 Restorative face oil €64 Hydrating serum €58 Body oil €48 Gift card From €25 Shop Journal Help About Contact Overview Buy Kinfolk Account Face Best seller Hydrating serum €58 5.0 (3 reviews) Three weights of hyaluronic acid with panthenol, for skin that feels tight after cleansing. 30 ml For all skin types Add to bag Product details A water light serum that holds moisture at three depths of the skin. Panthenol calms redness, and there is no fragrance at all. It layers under everything, so it fits any routine. Ingredients Aqua Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice Glycerin Sodium Hyaluronate Hydrolyzed Sodium Hyaluronate Sodium Hyaluronate Crosspolymer Panthenol Sodium Levulinate Citric Acid Key ingredients Hyaluronic acid Panthenol Glycerin Aloe leaf juice How to use Apply two pumps to damp skin after toning, then seal with cream or oil. Warnings For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes, and rinse well with water if it gets in. Patch test on the inside of your elbow before first use and stop if irritation develops. Keep out of reach of child
